mdnsDomain.description: Custom domain name for mDNS service (default: opencode.local)

cors.description: Additional domains to allow for CORS

tool.description: Glob matched against the tool name, e.g. `edit` or `bash`. Omit to match every tool.

file.description: Glob matched against the file path a tool touched, e.g. `**/*.ts`. Only meaningful for tools that act on a file.

command.description: Command and arguments to run, as an array — not passed through a shell, so no quoting or injection concerns.

matcher.description: Restricts which events fire this hook. Omit to fire on every occurrence of the event.

environment.description: Extra environment variables for the command, on top of the inherited environment.

timeout.description: Milliseconds before the command is killed. Defaults to 30000.

disabled.description: Set true to keep the hook configured but inactive.

name.description: A unique name for the source, e.g. "platform-kg". Shown as the label on everything it returns

type.description: "graph": a read-only query against a Neo4j knowledge graph. "mcp": a search tool on an MCP server configured under "mcp". "org": your organisation's team memory on its Lunos console (the console named by cloud.policy in managed config; needs lunos login)

jurisdiction.description: Where the source runs, e.g. "EU-DE", "EU" or "US". Required: checked against the residency policy before the source is first contacted. A source without one is never queried

enabled.description: Set to false to keep the source configured but never query it (default true)

max_tokens.description: Most tokens this source may add to a turn (default 500), within memory.retrieval.max_tokens overall

timeout_ms.description: How long a query may take before the source is skipped for that turn (default 2000)

trusted.description: Honoured only in managed config: results are labelled as organisation-managed and skip the instruction-pattern screen (secret screening and size caps still apply). Ignored anywhere else

url.description: graph: the Neo4j URL, e.g. "bolt+s://kg.internal:7687". Plain bolt:// or neo4j:// only to this machine

database.description: graph: the database to read (default: the server's default database)

query.description: graph: how nodes are found. "fulltext" (the default) uses a full-text index; "contains" matches node names containing a word of the question

index.description: graph, "fulltext": the full-text index to search (default: the first one the database has)

username.description: graph: the user to connect as, e.g. "{env:KG_USER}". Give it read-only rights

server.description: mcp: the name of a server under "mcp". Memory opens its own connection to it, after the residency check; set that server's "enabled" to false so the agent is not also given its tools

tool.description: mcp: the search tool to call, e.g. "search_memory_facts". Only this tool is ever called

argument.description: mcp: the tool argument that takes the query (default "query")

type.description: Where memory is stored: on this computer (the default), "neo4j", "postgres", or "memgraph" (not supported yet: refused when memory starts)

url.description: The database's URL: Bolt for Neo4j (bolt+s://graph.internal:7687), postgres:// for PostgreSQL (postgres://db.internal:5432/lunos). Unencrypted connections are only allowed to localhost, unless allow_insecure is set

database.description: Database name. Default: the server's default database (Neo4j Community has only one). Project and user memory are kept apart inside it

password.description: Database password, as "{env:VAR}" or "{file:path}". A literal password is refused

jurisdiction.description: Where the database runs, e.g. "EU-DE" or "US". Required for an external database; checked against the residency policy before any connection. "local" is accepted only for a database on this computer (localhost)

read_only.description: Recall only: nothing is written, and the remember tool isn't offered to the model

allow_insecure.description: Allow an unencrypted connection (bolt://, neo4j://, or postgres:// without TLS) to a host that isn't localhost. Credentials and facts then cross the network in clear text

user.description: Who you are in a shared database, for user memory (stored only as a hash). Default: a random id kept in the Lunos data directory, so user memory is per machine unless you set this

name.description: Short id, used by lunos memory setup --template

leaves.description: What leaves the computer, in plain words ("the fact text, to …")

memory.description: The memory block the template sets (backend, model, encryption, …). Credentials as {env:} references

custom.description: Templates added by your organisation, listed first

hide.description: Built-in templates to hide, by name (e.g. ["neo4j-docker"])

enabled.description: Turn on long-term memory (off by default). LUNOS_DISABLE_MEMORY=1 turns it off regardless of this setting

scope.description: Where memory is kept: "project" (.opencode/memory/graph/ in the project) and/or "user" (the Lunos data directory). Default ["project"]

model.description: Model that extracts facts and relationships when something is remembered: "inherit" (the main agent's model), "small" (small_model, the default) or "provider/model". Checked against the residency policy before memory starts

embedding.description: Embedding model: "local" (the default; computed on this machine, no network call after the one-time model download). Provider embeddings are not supported yet

max_tokens.description: Most tokens of recalled memory added to a turn (default 1500)

retrieval.description: How much memory is recalled into a turn

max_facts.description: Most facts kept per scope (default 5000). Remembering more is refused

sources.description: External, read-only memory sources (XCOD-135): a knowledge graph or an MCP memory server recalled alongside local memory. Their results are untrusted reference, labelled with the source and never stored locally

days.description: Facts expire this many days after they were saved (default: never). Hand-written notes never expire. Expired facts are not recalled, and are deleted after grace_days

grace_days.description: Days an expired fact is kept, not recalled, before it is deleted (default 7)

encryption.description: Encrypt the provenance ledger (facts.jsonl) with a key kept in the OS keychain: "os-keychain", or "off" (the default). The memory engine's own database files are not encrypted; use full-disk encryption for those

backend.description: Where memory is stored (XCOD-134): on this computer (the default), or a team database (Neo4j or PostgreSQL)

template.description: The memory template that set up this storage, e.g. "neo4j-docker". Written when a template is applied, so /memory and lunos memory status can show it; absent means set up by hand

templates.description: Memory setup templates (XCOD-264): your organisation's own, and built-in ones to hide. Read from managed config only, as written: {env:} references in a template stay references

amount.description: The budget for each period, in budget.currency

period.description: "monthly" (default): resets on reset_day each month. "weekly": resets every Monday. "total": one amount for the project, never reset

reset_day.description: With a monthly period: the day of the month it resets on, 1 to 28. Default 1

per_session.description: Most one session may spend, its subagents included, in budget.currency

per_day.description: Most the project may spend in one day, in budget.currency

on_limit.description: What happens at the limit for this budget; default budget.on_limit

When a turn may take a project over its budget. "warn": a warning, and the turn runs. "ask" (default): you choose to run it anyway, pick a cheaper model or stop. "stop": no new turn or step starts until the period resets or the budget is raised; a step already running finishes. In `lunos run`, CI and unattended runs nobody can answer, so "ask" stops, and the run exits with code 3

thresholds.description: Percentages of a budget at which you're alerted, once each per period. Default [50, 80, 100]

currency.description: The currency budgets are in: "EUR" (default) or "USD"

usd_rate.description: With budget.currency "EUR": what 1 USD is in EUR, for model prices (which are in USD). A fixed rate you set; Lunos never fetches one. Default 0.9

organisation.description: Your organisation's budget for everything Lunos spends on this computer. Enforced only from managed config locked with "$locked": ["budget.organisation"], so members see it but can't raise it. Where a project budget applies too, whichever is reached first stops

retention_days.description: Days a failed run's log is kept, beyond the newest 10 runs. Default 14

max_mb.description: Most space all run logs together may take, in MB; the oldest are removed first. Default 50

allow.description: Regions this deployment may send model requests to, e.g. ["eu"]. Providers outside this list are blocked before any request is made. Providers with no recorded jurisdiction are always denied. "configurable" providers (Azure, Bedrock, Vertex) are denied unless explicitly listed, because their region cannot be verified from here.

audit.description: Write an audit log of outbound model calls. Defaults to true whenever a residency policy is set; set false to opt out.

auditPath.description: Path of the audit log. Defaults to residency-egress.log in the Lunos data directory.

region.description: Where this endpoint processes data. Your declaration: Lunos can't verify it.

note.description: What the declaration rests on, recorded for reviewers, e.g. "vLLM on our Frankfurt servers"

endpoints.description: Jurisdictions this deployment declares for endpoints Lunos can't assess, keyed by provider id: self-hosted models (vLLM, Ollama) or a built-in provider pointed at another host. A declaration never changes a built-in provider's claim for its own API. Recorded in the audit log with basis "declared". Lock it with managed config ($locked: ["residency"]).

enabled.description: Allow Lunos to start Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions (default true). Lock it to turn it off

delegate.description: Give Lunos agents the external_agent tool, so they can hand a task to Claude Code (off by default). Every approval the tool asks for comes to you

path.description: The tool's executable, when it isn't on PATH

permission_mode.description: Claude Code's permission mode on every run. Unset or empty: manual approval (every edit and command asks in Lunos). bypassPermissions is refused here; pass it for one run only

path.description: The tool's executable, when it isn't on PATH

sandbox.description: Codex's sandbox on every run. Unset or empty: read-only. danger-full-access is refused here; pass it for one run only

approval_policy.description: Codex's approval policy on every run. Unset or empty: untrusted (anything beyond reading asks in Lunos). never is refused here; pass it for one run only

permission_mode.description: @deprecated Moved to sandbox / approval_policy: still read while those are unset, and saving either moves it

mcp.description: Offer Lunos's MCP servers to Claude Code / Codex through the Lunos bridge (default true)

skills.description: Offer Lunos's skills to Claude Code / Codex through the Lunos bridge (default true)

memory.description: Let Claude Code / Codex search and add to Lunos memory through the Lunos bridge, while memory is on (default true)

commands.description: List Lunos's custom commands, skills and MCP prompts in a Claude Code / Codex session (default true)

hooks.description: Run Lunos plugins' tool.execute.before / tool.execute.after hooks on Claude Code / Codex's own tool calls (default true). They run on this machine, so they don't need the sharing consent

share.description: What Claude Code / Codex sessions may use from Lunos, after you agree to share it with that tool. Their results are sent to Anthropic or OpenAI with your prompts

issuer.description: OpenID Connect issuer URL that lunos login signs in to, e.g. https://id.example.eu/realms/lunos (default https://auth.lunos.tech/realms/Lunos)

client_id.description: OAuth client id registered for the Lunos CLI at that issuer (default "lunos-cli")

endpoint.description: Lunos Cloud control plane that lunos run --cloud dispatches runs to (https, or localhost for testing), e.g. https://cloud.lunos.tech

policy.description: Your organisation's policy on its Lunos console, fetched at start while you're signed in (lunos login), e.g. https://console.example.eu/v1/orgs/acme/policy. Only read from managed config

client_start.description: Tell your organisation's Lunos console (cloud.policy) when Lunos starts: version, OS, architecture, surface, a random install id and the policy in effect (default true). Read from managed and user config only; your organisation can lock it on

cost_report.description: Report each model step's cost to your organisation's Lunos console (cloud.policy), so it can add up organisation project budgets: the amount, the model and the project's id, never content (default false). Read from managed and user config only; never sent for a personal account

auto_team.description: Turn on team features (organisation policy, private marketplace, team memory, sharing) for your hosted Lunos organisation after lunos login, without cloud.policy (default true). Only read from managed config; set false to turn it off

required.description: Whether the TUI asks you to sign in to a free Lunos account before the first session (default true in the official build, false in a build from source). Only read from managed config; false skips the sign-in screen and makes no Lunos account call

project.description: Lunos space project this directory's sessions sync to (lunos sync link writes it)

exclude.description: Globs of files whose contents are never uploaded, in addition to .env*, auth.json, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*

background.description: Allow subagents to run in the background while the main agent keeps working (on by default; false turns it off). OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS still turns it on

delegate.description: Have the Build agent split development work across subagents running in parallel (on by default; false leaves delegation to the model)

max_parallel.description: At most this many subagents run at once per session; more wait their turn (default 3)

fun_names.description: Give subagents funny names in the TUI, such as "Turbo Pickle" (on by default; false shows "Subagent 1")

mascots.description: Show each subagent's pixel-art animal in the TUI sidebar (on by default)

model.description: Default model for every subagent without its own agent.<name>.model: "inherit" (the main agent's model, the default), "small" (small_model) or "provider/model"

variant.description: Reasoning variant for subagents whose model is overridden: "inherit" or a variant name

enabled.description: Let the main agent choose a model per task call, from `allow` only

allow.description: Models the main agent may choose per task call ("provider/model")

dynamic.description: Per-task model selection by the main agent

build.description: Command that builds or compiles the project, e.g. "npm run build" or "dotnet build"

test.description: Command that runs the tests, e.g. "npm test"

start.description: Command that starts the app, run in the background, e.g. "npm run dev"

ready.description: Local URL that answers once the app is up, e.g. "http://localhost:4200"

check.description: Requests to make against the running app and the status they must return, e.g. ["GET /api/health -> 200"]

max_attempts.description: How many times the agent fixes a failed check and verifies again before handing back with the failure (default 3)

timeout.description: Time budget for verification in minutes, in total (default 10)

auto_continue.description: Continue automatically when a Dev-Cycle turn ends by announcing its next step instead of doing it (on by default; false waits for you to say proceed). Never passes a pending gate, and stops after 3 continuations in a row without progress

dynamic.description: Build and Dev-Cycle plan the work and dispatch subagents to do it; the main agent keeps only read, search, todo and question tools (on by default; false has the main agent do the work itself, with subagents encouraged by subagent.delegate). /workflows on|off switches it for one session

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent (applies only when using the agent's configured model).

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (default: false, only applies to mode: subagent)

color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

verify.description: Build agent: check the work (build, tests, start the app and try it) before handing back (default true). false restores handing back without checking (XCOD-288)

auto_continue.description: Build agent: continue automatically when a turn ends by announcing its next step instead of doing it (default true). Dev-Cycle uses dev_cycle.auto_continue; Plan never continues (XCOD-302)

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL for copilot authentication

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for full requests to this provider. Set to false to disable timeout.

headerTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for response headers (default: 300000). Set to false to disable timeout.

chunkTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds between streamed SSE chunks for this provider (default: 300000). If no chunk arrives within this window, the request is aborted. Set to false to disable timeout.

reasoning_options.description: Reasoning controls the model accepts, used to build its variants

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP server process. Relative paths resolve from the workspace directory.

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

callbackPort.description: Port for the local OAuth callback server (default: 19876). Shorthand for redirectUri when only the port needs changing. Ignored if redirectUri is set.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

auto_resize.description: Resize images before sending them to the model when they exceed configured limits (default: true)

max_width.description: Maximum image width before resizing or rejecting the attachment (default: 2000)

max_height.description: Maximum image height before resizing or rejecting the attachment (default: 2000)

max_base64_bytes.description: Maximum base64 payload bytes for an image attachment (default: 5242880)

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

$locked.description: Organisation policy: keys that user and project config, environment variables, CLI flags and in-session commands can't change. Only read from managed config (system directory or MDM profile). Lockable keys: residency, share, enabled_providers, disabled_providers, marketplace, marketplace_default, marketplace_allow, marketplace_unreviewed, autoupdate, memory, memory.enabled, audit, audit.enabled, audit.path, audit.forward, sandbox, sandbox.required, log, resources, permission (every permission, including each agent's own) and permission.<tool> (one tool's rule, e.g. permission.webfetch)

shell.description: Default shell to use for terminal and bash tool

server.description: Server configuration for opencode serve and web commands

urls.description: URLs to fetch skills from (e.g., https://example.com/.well-known/skills/)

hooks.description: Shell commands to run on tool, command, and session lifecycle events, without writing a plugin

enabled.description: Write the organisation audit trail: model calls, tool runs, permission decisions, MCP connections, marketplace installs, policy refusals and upgrades. Also on whenever a residency policy is set with audit on

path.description: Audit log path. Takes precedence over residency.auditPath. Default: residency-egress.log in the Lunos log directory

redact.description: Regular expressions whose matches are masked in recorded paths and command lines, on top of the built-in secret patterns

max_bytes.description: Rotate the log when it reaches this size (default 10 MB)

max_age_days.description: Delete rotated log files older than this (default 90)

syslog.description: Forward every line to a syslog receiver, e.g. udp://siem.internal:514

otlp.description: Forward every line as an OTLP log record, e.g. https://collector.internal:4318

region.description: Where the forwarding destinations process data, checked against residency.allow (without it they count as "unknown"). Your declaration: Lunos can't verify it. Set it in managed config and lock audit.forward so only an administrator can declare it

memory.description: Graph-based long-term memory, off by default

budget.description: Project budgets: what happens at the limit, alert thresholds, the currency, and the organisation's budget (managed config)

enabled.description: Run `lunos` and `lunos run` in a sandbox, as if --sandbox were passed (--no-sandbox overrides it for one run). Any config layer turning it on wins. Other commands, such as serve, web and acp, still run on the host. Off by default

required.description: Nothing runs on this machine except in a sandbox: `lunos` and `lunos run` always start one, --no-sandbox is refused, `lunos serve`, `web`, `acp`, `github` and `pr` refuse to start, and any agent tool call outside a sandbox is refused. Meant for managed config, locked with "$locked": ["sandbox.required"]. Off by default

image.description: Container image with Lunos as its entry point. Default ghcr.io/axsiondev/lunos:<the CLI's version>. The image is pinned by digest when the sandbox is created

workspace.description: How the project gets into the sandbox. "copy" (default): cloned into a container volume at the current commit, with uncommitted changes applied; the host working tree is never mounted. "mount": your working tree itself, bind-mounted read-write, so the agent's changes are in it as they happen (no branch or patch); .git and Lunos's own config stay read-only. Reduced isolation, and a warning is shown. Read from your global and managed config only, never a repository's

devcontainer.description: Use the project's .devcontainer/devcontainer.json for the sandbox's toolchain, unless the project's own config sets sandbox.image. A sandbox.image in your global or managed config is the Lunos image the devcontainer gets Lunos from. "image" (default): its `image`, with Lunos added (nothing of the image runs on this machine). "build": also its `build` (Dockerfile), which runs the repository's build steps on this machine, with the network open; only your global or managed config can choose it. "off": ignore it. A repository's config can only turn it off

target.description: Absolute path in the sandbox. Default: the same as source

mounts.description: Extra directories mounted read-only into the sandbox, e.g. a package cache. Read from your global and managed config only, never a repository's. Your home directory itself, /, SSH keys and container runtime sockets are refused

on_finish.description: What happens once the results are back on the host: "destroy" (default) removes the container and its volume, "retain" stops it so `lunos sandbox attach` can reopen it, "destroy_on_success" keeps it only when the task failed. --keep and --rm override it for one run. A failed handoff always retains

retain_for.description: How long a retained sandbox is kept, e.g. "72h", "30m" or "7d". Once it has expired, `lunos sandbox prune` removes it, and so does the next sandboxed run or `lunos sandbox` command. Unset: kept until destroyed

network.description: What the sandbox can reach. "policy" (default): only the model endpoints the residency policy allows, remote MCP servers, the npm registry and sandbox.allow, enforced by an egress proxy outside the container. "none": nothing. "open": anything this machine can reach (a warning is shown). A repository's config can only make it stricter

allow.description: Extra hosts the sandbox may reach under network "policy", as "host" (port 443) or "host:port". Read from your global and managed config only, never a repository's

results.description: How the agent's changes come back: "branch" (default) as branch lunos/sandbox/<id>, "patch" as .opencode/sandbox/<id>/changes.patch (only the agent's changes, for `git apply`), "none" not at all. The transcript and summary always come back

runtime.description: The container runtime. Unset: Docker if it's available, else Podman

cpus.description: CPUs the sandbox may use (docker --cpus). Default 2

pids.description: Most processes the sandbox may run at once (docker --pids-limit). Default 512

tmp.description: Size of the in-memory /tmp (the only writable path besides the workspace), e.g. "1g". Default "1g"

resources.description: CPU, memory, process and /tmp limits for the sandbox container

sandbox.description: Sandboxed runs: the Lunos server and everything it spawns run in a Docker container

log.description: How long run logs are kept: failed runs' logs for retention_days, all within max_mb

residency.description: Data-residency policy restricting which provider jurisdictions this deployment may use, with an audit log of outbound model calls

references.description: Named git or local directory references

path.description: A file or folder on this computer. In a project's config it must be inside the project: anything else is a personal resource

include.description: Globs of files to include, relative to the folder. Default ["**/*"]

exclude.description: Globs of files to leave out, relative to the folder

description.description: What the resource is for, shown to the agent

mode.description: "always": in every session's context, within resources.always_tokens. "search" (default): indexed on this computer, and the agent pulls in the relevant parts with project_resources_search. "on_demand": only when a prompt mentions @name

url.description: A web page or docs site (http or https)

depth.description: How many links deep to follow on the same site. Default 0 (the page only)

description.description: What the resource is for, shown to the agent

mode.description: "always": in every session's context, within resources.always_tokens. "search" (default): indexed on this computer, and the agent pulls in the relevant parts with project_resources_search. "on_demand": only when a prompt mentions @name

repository.description: A git repository URL, cloned on this computer

branch.description: Branch or tag. Default: the remote default

include.description: Globs of files to include. Default ["**/*"]

exclude.description: Globs of files to leave out

description.description: What the resource is for, shown to the agent

mode.description: "always": in every session's context, within resources.always_tokens. "search" (default): indexed on this computer, and the agent pulls in the relevant parts with project_resources_search. "on_demand": only when a prompt mentions @name

uri.description: The resource's URI on that server

description.description: What the resource is for, shown to the agent

mode.description: "always": in every session's context, within resources.always_tokens. "search" (default): indexed on this computer, and the agent pulls in the relevant parts with project_resources_search. "on_demand": only when a prompt mentions @name

entries.description: Resources by name. The name is also the resource's @alias in prompts

always_tokens.description: Most tokens "always" resources may add to every session's context. Default 8000

max_resource_mb.description: Largest a single resource may be. Default 50

max_index_mb.description: Largest the project's resource index may grow. Default 1024

refresh_hours.description: How often web, git and MCP resources are fetched again. Default 24

web.description: Allow web page resources. Default true; an organisation can turn them off in managed config

resources.description: Project resources (XCOD-300): files, folders, repositories, web pages and MCP resources given to the agent as context, always or searched when relevant

reference.description: @deprecated Use 'references' field instead. Named git or local directory references

snapshot.description: Enable or disable snapshot tracking. When false, filesystem snapshots are not recorded and undoing or reverting will not undo/redo file changes. Defaults to true.

share.description: Control sharing behavior:'manual' allows manual sharing via commands, 'auto' enables automatic sharing, 'disabled' disables all sharing, 'cloud' shares only with your organisation's Lunos console (/share, lunos share, lunos memory share; never another share service)

autoshare.description: @deprecated Use 'share' field instead. Share newly created sessions automatically

autoupdate.description: Automatically update to the latest version. Set to true to auto-update, false to disable, or 'notify' to show update notifications

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-2

small_model.description: Small model to use for tasks like title generation in the format of provider/model

recommended.description: Curated models the model pickers list under Recommended, as "provider/model": "why". Replaces Lunos's built-in list; lock it with $locked to set it for an organisation

default_agent.description: Default agent to use when none is specified. Must be a primary agent. Falls back to 'build' if not set or if the specified agent is invalid.

external.description: Drive Claude Code and Codex CLI from Lunos with your own installs (XCOD-204)

cloud.description: Lunos Cloud sign-in: the identity provider lunos login uses (XCOD-185)

auth.description: Whether the TUI needs a Lunos account to start (XCOD-273). Only read from managed config

sync.description: Session sync to your Lunos space: false to stop it for this directory, or { project, exclude }

subagent.description: Subagents: whether Build delegates to them, background runs, how many run at once, their model, and their names and animals in the TUI

verify.description: How the Build agent checks its work before handing back: build, test and start commands, the ready URL and checks (XCOD-288)

dev_cycle.description: Dev-Cycle mode: whether it continues by itself between gates (XCOD-302)

workflows.description: Dynamic workflows: whether Build and Dev-Cycle dispatch subagents to do the work (XCOD-303)

subagent_depth.description: Maximum subagent nesting depth. Defaults to 1, which prevents subagents from launching subagents.

username.description: Custom username to display in conversations instead of system username

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

formatter.description: Enable or configure formatters. Omit or set to false to disable, true to enable built-ins, or an object to enable built-ins with overrides.

lsp.description: Enable or configure LSP servers. On by default; set to false to disable all, or an object to enable built-ins with overrides.

instructions.description: Additional instruction files or patterns to include

attachment.description: Attachment processing configuration, including image size limits and resizing behavior

marketplace.description: Marketplace sources (manifest URL, owner/repo or path) to list and install from

marketplace_default.description: Whether the built-in lunos-community marketplace is used (default: true)

agent_import.description: Whether `lunos agent import` may add agents from bundles and Claude Code files (default: true). Organisation policy: lock it in managed config to forbid imports

marketplace_unreviewed.description: Organisation policy: false forbids installing marketplace entries that aren't verified (--allow-unreviewed), when locked in managed config

marketplace_allow.description: Organisation policy: the only marketplace sources that may be listed and installed from, when locked in managed config

max_lines.description: Maximum lines of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 2000)

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 51200)

tool_output.description: Thresholds for truncating tool output. When output exceeds either limit, the full text is written to the truncation directory and a preview is returned.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs (default: false)

tail_turns.description: Maximum number of recent user turns, including their following assistant/tool responses, to keep verbatim during compaction. By default retention is limited only by the preserved token budget.

preserve_recent_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens from recent turns to preserve verbatim after compaction

reserved.description: Token buffer for compaction. Leaves enough window to avoid overflow during compaction.

openTelemetry.description: Enable OpenTelemetry spans for AI SDK calls (using the 'experimental_telemetry' flag)

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

policies.description: Policy statements applied to supported resources, such as provider access
